environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in an ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The task definition specifies a linuxParameters.seccompProfile pointing to a custom profile stored in SSM Parameter Store (/ecs/seccomp/flask-hardened-v3). This profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode with a whitelist approach: it permits read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, msync, mincore, madvise, shmget, shmat, shmctl, dup, dup2, pause, nanosleep, getitimer, alarm, setitimer, getpid, sendfile, accept, bind, listen, getsockname, getpeername, recvfrom, sendmsg, recvmsg, shutdown, setsockopt, getsockopt, clone, uname, fcntl, flock, fsync, fdatasync, truncate, getdents, getcwd, chdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, link, unlink, readlink, chmod, fchmod, chown, fchown, lchown, umask, gettimeofday, getrlimit, getrusage, sysinfo, times, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, setpgid, getppid, getpgrp, setsid, setreuid, setregid, getgroups, setgroups, setresuid, setresgid, getresuid, getresgid, sigaltstack, statfs, fstatfs, prctl, arch_prctl, futex, set_tid_address, clock_gettime, clock_getres, clock_nanosleep, exit_group, epoll_wait, epoll_ctl, tgkill, openat, newfstatat, set_robust_list, epoll_create1, eventfd2, timerfd_create, timerfd_settime, prlimit64, getrandom. Notably ABSENT from whitelist: execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, socket (new socket creation), connect (outbound connections). The accept syscall IS permitted since gunicorn needs to accept incoming connections on the already-bound listening socket inherited from the parent. The container's network interface is managed by the Fargate ENI with the listening socket pre-bound before seccomp enforcement. Additionally, /proc/self/environ is mounted read-only via a tmpfs overlay preventing environment variable exfiltration through /proc filesystem traversal.

config.network: ALB -> Fargate ENI, no direct internet exposure from container
config.socket_inheritance: listening socket fd inherited pre-seccomp, accept() permitted, socket()/connect() blocked
